# Materials review

Own `ReviewReport` with stable findings and a release recommendation. Accept a material package directly or receive artifact IDs through the orchestrator. Use `references/education/contracts.json` when bundled. If it is absent, keep the same named fields in a readable report and disclose that machine validation is unavailable.

## Inputs and outputs

Obtain the exact artifact versions, audience, objective and curriculum maps, source anchors, assessment blueprint, item keys, intended language, accessibility constraints and delivery format. Report each finding with severity, artifact and section or item ID, observed evidence, expected behavior, recommended owner, retest scope and status. Distinguish an independent agent review when available from a separate pass by the original agent. Neither is a qualified human subject expert.

## Procedure

1. Inspect the actual teaching and scored content. Check factual claims and source fidelity, prerequisite sequence, objective coverage, worked steps, answer keys, alternative valid responses, rubric totals, assessment fairness, language and accessibility. Inspect rendering when it is part of the requested deliverable and tools allow.
2. Recompute sampled numeric answers and verify cited source locations. Look for unsupported official claims and irrelevant or inaccessible visuals. Test whether a learner can understand instructions without hidden teacher context.
3. Route defects to their artifact owner. Curriculum alignment returns to curriculum analysis, teaching explanations to instructional design, and items or scoring to assessment design. The reviewer records revisions and retests, rather than silently changing canonical material.
4. Recheck changed sections and affected dependencies. A critical factual error, wrong key, fabricated source or requirement, essential objective gap, materially ambiguous scored item, serious accessibility barrier or unsafe content blocks release. Record residual limitations and a recommendation for each version.

An aggregate score cannot override a blocking finding. High-stakes release requires qualified human subject and assessment review. Apply applicable rule IDs from `references/education/evidence.json` as review criteria only where their conditions fit.

## Checks and examples

A request to audit a workbook containing a suspect answer key activates this skill. A request to author a workbook from an empty syllabus belongs to instructional design and assessment design. In a literature exercise, a rubric that rejects a defensible text-grounded interpretation is a scoring finding. For an unavailable official source, flag alignment as unverified and recommend a provisional label. Hand the report and retest scope back to the orchestrator.
